one.title: About you
one.subtitle: Brands see this first. You can change it later.

two.title: Where and what
two.subtitle: So we show you campaigns that fit.

name.label: Your name, as brands will see it
name.hint: Your own name or your page's name.

handle.label: Handle
handle.hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores. 3 to 30 characters.

city.label: City
city.hint: Where you live, or where you make most of your content.

niches.full: That's 5. Remove one to pick another.

dob.label: Date of birth
dob.hint: Used once to confirm you are 18 or over. We don't keep it.

onboarding.draftKept: What you type is kept on this device until you finish. Your date of birth is not.

errors.nameMissing: Enter the name brands will see.
errors.nameLong: Keep the name to 100 characters or fewer.
errors.handleShape: Use 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
errors.handleTaken: That handle is taken. Try another, for example with your city added.
errors.cityLong: Keep the city to 60 characters or fewer.
errors.dobInvalid: Enter a real date in the past.
errors.underage: Colyv is for people 18 or over, so you can't sign up yet.

brandSoon.title: Brand setup is being built
brandSoon.body: It is next on the list. Your Today screen already shows what needs you.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: Open campaigns from brands in Tamil Nadu. Pay and terms are shown before you apply.

empty.filteredBody: Try clearing a filter. New campaigns appear here as brands post them.
empty.noneBody: Brands post new campaigns every week. Check back soon.

discover.end: That's every open campaign that matches.

pay.barter: Barter: products or services, no fee

record.title: This brand's payment record
record.source: Counted from deals on Colyv, as marked by the brand and the creator. A record, not a rating.
record.noHistory: Fewer than 3 finished deals on Colyv, so there is no history yet. That says nothing good or bad.
record.paid: Marked {paid} of {settled} finished deals as paid, with {creators} different creators
record.paidOne: Marked {paid} of {settled} finished deals as paid, all with one creator
record.onTime: Paid by the due date in {percent}% of {settled} finished deals
record.medianDays: Half were marked paid within {days} days of the work being approved
record.overdue: {count} payments to creators are overdue right now
record.overdueOne: 1 payment to a creator is overdue right now
record.nameFlag: This brand's name looks like another brand's, and it hasn't verified that brand's website. Check before you agree to anything.

campaign.closed: Applications for this campaign have closed.

notFound.title: This campaign isn't available
notFound.body: It may have closed or been taken down. Browse other open campaigns.

withheld.title: This campaign is unavailable for legal reasons
withheld.body: It was taken down after a legal request or a report the law asks us to act on.

apply.title: Apply to {title}

pitch.label: Why you're a good fit
pitch.hint: Who your audience is, and an idea for this campaign.

quote.label: Your quote (optional)
quote.hint: In rupees. Leave it blank for barter or commission.

apply.aboveBudget: That's above this campaign's maximum of {max}. You can still send it, but brands often say no to quotes over their budget.
apply.draftKept: Your words are kept on this device until you send them.
apply.safety: You never pay to get a deal. If anyone asks you for a fee or a deposit, don't pay, and report them.

sent.title: Application sent
sent.body: {brand} can see it now. You'll get a notification when they answer.

apply.keptNote: Your words are kept. Try again when you're ready.

errors.pitchLong: Keep it to 1,000 characters or fewer.
errors.quoteInvalid: Enter an amount in rupees, such as 5000.
errors.pitchCheck: Check your pitch: it needs 20 to 1,000 characters.

refused.alreadyApplied: You've already applied to this campaign.
refused.closed: Applications for this campaign have closed.
refused.noProfile: Set up your profile first, then apply.
refused.withheld: Your profile is withheld for legal reasons, so you can't apply to new campaigns until that is lifted.
refused.campaignWithheld: This campaign is unavailable for legal reasons.
refused.gone: This campaign is no longer available.
refused.invited: This brand has already invited you to this campaign. Answer the invitation instead.

flags.label: Be careful
flags.asksForMoney: This text asks for money. On Colyv you never pay to get a deal.
flags.contact: This text has contact details. Keep talking on Colyv until a deal is agreed.
flags.upi: This text has a UPI ID. You never pay to get a deal.

applications.title: My applications
applications.subtitle: Where each one stands, with the date it last changed.

reason.audience_mismatch: Your audience wasn't the right fit
reason.incomplete_profile: Your profile wasn't complete enough to decide

applications.invitedNote: Answering invitations is being built. It will be on Today.
applications.campaignGone: This campaign isn't open any more

withdraw.title: Withdraw this application?
withdraw.body: The brand will no longer consider it. This is final.
withdraw.changed: Its status changed since this page loaded. The list now shows where it stands.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.body: Find an open campaign that fits and apply in a few minutes.

feedback.title: What your applications show
feedback.commonReason: Most common reason across your {count} rejections: {reason}
feedback.quotesAbove: {above} of your {compared} quotes were above the campaign's maximum budget.
feedback.open: {count} open campaigns in your niches you haven't applied to yet.
feedback.openOne: 1 open campaign in your niches you haven't applied to yet.

noProfile.title: Set up your profile first
noProfile.body: Your applications appear here once you have a profile and apply to a campaign.

domain.registered: The domain registry says it was registered on {date}.
domain.recent: This website was registered recently, on {date}. Take extra care before you agree to anything.

spam.title: Spam or a scam
spam.hint: For example, it asks you to pay a fee or a deposit.

fake_profile.title: A fake brand
fake_profile.hint: It is not who it says it is.

non_payment.title: It did not pay
non_payment.hint: Work was delivered and the money never came.

impersonation.title: Pretending to be me
impersonation.hint: It uses your name, photos or account.

intimate_content.title: Intimate images of me
intimate_content.hint: Something shows you undressed or sexually, real or made up.

report.noteHint: What happened, in your words. Only our team reads it.
report.noteLong: Keep the note to 1,000 characters or fewer.
report.already: You've already reported this, and that report is still open.
report.within2h: We aim to look at it within 2 hours. You'll get a notification when it is resolved.
report.within36h: We aim to look at it within 36 hours. You'll get a notification when it is resolved.
report.within7d: We aim to look at it within 7 days. You'll get a notification when it is resolved.
report.stillSending: Your report is still being sent. Wait a moment, then try again.
report.gone: This can't be reported any more: it may have been removed.

block.title: Block {brand}
block.what: They won't be told. From then on neither of you can start anything new with the other: no applications, no invitations, and you won't see their campaigns. Deals already agreed carry on.
block.done: Blocked. You won't see that brand's campaigns, and neither of you can start anything new with the other. Deals already agreed carry on. They were not told.

coming.title: Coming up
coming.empty: Nothing is dated yet. Deal dates appear here once a memo is agreed.

applications.title: Your applications
applications.empty: You have not applied to a campaign yet.

campaigns.title: Your campaigns
campaigns.empty: No campaign is running. Start one and creators can apply.

collabs.title: Collaborations
collabs.empty: No deal is running. Send a memo to a creator who applied.

performance.title: Post performance
performance.source: Read from the creators' screenshots, not verified.
performance.approximate: Some figures were shown rounded on the screenshot (like 12.5K), so these are not exact.
performance.markedWrong: Readings a creator marked as wrong are left out.
performance.empty: No post numbers yet. They appear once a creator sends a screenshot of the post's insights.
performance.error: Post numbers could not be loaded.

list.title: Campaigns
list.subtitle: Everything you are running, and how each one is doing.

empty.title: Start your first campaign
empty.body: Four steps, and each one is on the record.

steps.1: Write what you need and set a budget
steps.2: Creators apply, and you choose who to work with
steps.3: Agree the terms in a memo
steps.4: Approve the work and mark the payment

stages.title: Deals by stage
stages.none: No deal yet. Send a memo to a creator who applied.

money.title: Money
money.note: You pay creators directly. Colyv records it.

creators.title: Collaborations
creators.empty: No creator has a deal on this campaign yet.

insights.title: Insights
insights.engagementNote: Calculated from the numbers read: likes, comments, saves and shares over views (over reach when no views were shown).
insights.hint: Select a post to see its numbers, its checks and the screenshot.

post.title: {name}'s post
post.alt: The creator's screenshot of the post's insights
post.handle: The handle on it is the creator's linked channel
post.date: The post date is within the deal
post.consistent: The numbers agree with each other
post.vsStated: Views against what they said they usually get: {ratio} times
post.error: The evidence could not be loaded.
post.none: No screenshot has been read yet.
post.wrong: The creator marked this reading as wrong.

view.reportError: The numbers for this campaign could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.

notFound.title: We could not find this campaign
notFound.body: It may have been removed, or the link may be wrong. Your campaigns are all on one page.

first.title: Your first steps
first.body: Nothing is running yet. This is how a deal goes.
